# Kids Dental Studio

> A pediatric dental clinic in Ahmedabad specializing in comprehensive dental care for children, from preventive treatments to restorative and emergency procedures.

Kids Dental Studio is led by pediatric dentists Dr. Kisha Mehta and Dr. Umangi Lekhadia, located in Navrangpura, Ahmedabad. The clinic offers a full range of child-focused dental services including preventive care, restorative treatments, habit-breaking appliances, and emergency dental injury management.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric dentistry
- Kids dental care
- Child dental health
- Restorative dentistry
- Root canal treatment
- Pulp therapy
- Baby teeth
- First dental visit
- Dental crowns
- Space maintainers
- Habit-breaking appliances
- Sports mouthguards
- Fluoride application
- Dental injuries
- Teething
